title: Shipping failure-retrospective v1: fixes reopened the hole they closed

attempts.hypothesis_or_approach: Close review finding F7 (attempt-to-learning closure correlation) by scoping closure rules 5.1/5.2 to a learning's optional attempt_refs list
attempts.changed_next: The round-2 review re-ran its original adversarial probes instead of re-reading the diff and found F16: an unresolvable attempt_refs entry silently disabled rules 5.1/5.2 (fail-open). The fix was amended to emit unknown-attempt-ref findings and fall back to the record-level correlation, with a regression test asserting both halves.

attempts.hypothesis_or_approach: Amend the F7 fix to fail closed: unresolvable refs become findings and the record-level correlation re-engages

learnings.claim: A review fix can reopen the exact hole it closes in a more deniable form; re-verification after fixes must RE-RUN the original adversarial probes, not re-read the diff - two of this change's three blocking findings were introduced or left by fixes, and only probe re-runs caught them.
applies_when: re-verifying a change after review fixes were applied
a fix touches the same code path a blocking finding exercised
does_not_apply_when: the fix is a pure text/wording change with no executable surface
the original review carried no executable probes to re-run

existing_skill_absorption.rationale: The playbook's review contract (directive section 16: re-verify after fixes) already owns this; the delta is the re-probe-not-re-read wording, absorbed into this pack and the ExecPlan's decision log rather than a new skill. The reviewer's round-2/round-3 practice is the positive worked example.

retention_actions.closure_condition: The review report's round-2/3 probe tables stand as the worked example cited by this learning.
This pack passes the learning artifact lint in CI.
